steps.text: Market value break on RY in QNT-009: USD 10,772.92. If quantities agree, the gap is price or FX. I'll split it into a price effect and an FX effect and see which one carries it.
Same quantity (24,400). Price effect USD 0.00, FX effect USD 10,772.92, sum USD 10,772.92.
IBOR golden copy vs vendor closes
CAD/USD fixings around the as-of date
IBOR valued CAD at 0.72605315 (WMR_4PM 2026-11-19); custodian used WMR 4pm 2026-11-20 at 0.72341559.
Conclusion: fx, 97% confidence. Owner: Market Data - FX.

queries.sql:
SELECT
  b.break_id,
  b.as_of,
  b.account_id,
  b.security_id,
  s.ticker,
  s.isin,
  s.currency AS sec_ccy,
  s.country,
  b.currency,
  b.break_type,
  b.ibor_value,
  b.custodian_value,
  b.difference,
  b.difference_usd,
  b.status
FROM breaks AS b
LEFT JOIN securities AS s
  ON s.security_id = b.security_id
WHERE
  b.break_id = 'BRK-0172'
LIMIT 200

SELECT
  *
FROM (
  SELECT
    'IBOR' AS book,
    quantity,
    price,
    price_date,
    fx_rate,
    fx_source,
    fx_rate_date,
    local_mv,
    base_mv
  FROM ibor_positions
  WHERE
    account_id = 'QNT-009' AND security_id = 1038
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'CUSTODIAN' AS book,
    quantity,
    price,
    as_of AS price_date,
    fx_rate,
    'WMR_4PM' AS fx_source,
    as_of AS fx_rate_date,
    local_mv,
    base_mv
  FROM custodian_positions
  WHERE
    account_id = 'QNT-009' AND security_id = 1038
) AS u
LIMIT 200

queries.sql:
SELECT
  price_date,
  source,
  close_price,
  loaded_at
FROM prices
WHERE
  security_id = 1038 AND price_date >= '2026-11-14'
ORDER BY
  price_date DESC,
  source
LIMIT 200

queries.purpose: CAD/USD fixings around the as-of date
queries.sql:
SELECT
  rate_date,
  source,
  rate_to_usd
FROM fx_rates
WHERE
  currency = 'CAD' AND rate_date >= '2026-11-16'
ORDER BY
  rate_date DESC,
  source
LIMIT 200
